mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods with a 3-month FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration and weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive Fed policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,350,000 units, it signals a cooling housing market and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1350.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods with a 3-month INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), a decline in residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) below 680,000 million dollars signals reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of cases when RSAFS < 680000.0.
